raw.description:
Cosmic Gate takes over Superior Ingredients Rooftop on Sunday, November 8, joined by Sinca, Derya Zor, sunrYse, and 4YÛ.

For more than 27 years, German artist Nic Chagall has built Cosmic Gate into one of trance’s most recognized names. His catalog includes genre classics “Fire Wire” and “Exploration of Space,” alongside fan favorites such as “am2pm,” “Fall Into You,” “Nothing To Hide,” and “Your Mind.”

GRAMMY-nominated and once named the highest climber in DJ Mag’s Top 100, Cosmic Gate has performed at Tomorrowland, EDC, Ultra, Creamfields, Dreamstate, Transmission, and A State of Trance. His remix catalog includes music from Armin van Buuren, Tiësto, deadmau5, Above & Beyond, and Gabriel & Dresden. He also runs Wake Your Mind Records and hosts the weekly WYM Radio show.

Joining him is Montréal DJ and producer Sinca, whose sets move between progressive house, classic house, minimal, and indie dance. Her music has appeared on Purified, Bedrock, Anjunadeep, All Day I Dream, and Days Like Nights, with performances at Coachella’s Do LaB, Burning Man, SXM Festival, Stereo Montréal, Brooklyn Mirage, and Akasha Ibiza.

Local artists Derya Zor, sunrYse, and 4YÛ complete the lineup for a Sunday above Brooklyn.

raw.description:
Superior Roof welcomes UK producers Cam Stockman and Tommy Phillips for a special Sunday Funday doubleheader on December 13.

Manchester’s Cam Stockman brings a sharp mix of house, electro, minimal, and breakbeat, with ’90s dance music running through his productions and sets. His releases have landed on labels including LOCUS and Whoyostro, while his Suburbia parties have hosted selectors such as Voigtmann, Laidlaw, and Alec Falconer.

Tommy Phillips joins him following a run of acclaimed releases and international shows. His music has received support from Jamie Jones, Max Dean, Seth Troxler, and Mau P, while his official remix of deadmau5 and Kaskade’s “I Remember” has surpassed one million streams. His “Fixation” EP also reached number one on Beatport’s singles chart.

**Two UK talents, one rooftop, and a proper Sunday session above the city. Join us at Superior Roof and finish the weekend on the dance floor.**

TWO DISTINCT SPACES. ONE ICONIC WILLIAMSBURG DESTINATION.

Ring in 2027 at Superior Ingredients inside 74Wythe with two unforgettable ways to celebrate: The Room and The Roof.

From the high-energy dance floor of The Room to the elevated vibes and Manhattan skyline views of The Roof, choose your atmosphere or experience both with All Access.

The night kicks off at 9 PM with a 5-hour premium open bar, special guest DJs, and nonstop Brooklyn nightlife energy, running until 4 AM. At midnight, raise a glass with a complimentary champagne toast as we count down to 2027.

THE ROOM

State-of-the-art sound, immersive lighting, and a high-energy dance floor deliver the ultimate late-night club experience.

THE ROOF

Head upstairs for music, cocktails, elevated atmosphere, and stunning Manhattan skyline views.

GO ALL ACCESS

Why choose one? All Access unlocks BOTH The Room + The Roof, letting you move freely between spaces all night. Dance downstairs, take in the skyline upstairs, and experience everything Superior Ingredients has to offer.

Standard tickets grant access to the area specified. All Access is required to move between The Room and The Roof.
